newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cabinet to debate LOT, PZU sales Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Polish cabinet to debate LOT, PZU sales Wednesday.

text.p: Poland's government is scheduled to discuss on Wednesday plans to privatise air carrier PLL LOT SA and the country's largest insurer, Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU), the government press office said.
"The council of ministers will debate offering shares of LOT and PZU on the market," an office official told Reuters.
LOT spokesman Anna Popek said she hoped the discussion would soon trigger the airline's long-delayed privatisation.
The government has said it would sell up to 49 percent of LOT, most likely to several passive investors, and possibly offer some of its shares on the bourse.
PZU has said it plans a new share issue of between 250 million and 750 million zlotys next year.
